environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed as a Kubernetes pod in a cluster running v1.22 with PodSecurityPolicy admission controller disabled (legacy cluster migrated from v1.18). Pod runs with privileged: true and hostPath volume mounting / into /host-root. Container runs as root (UID 0). No network policies restrict inter-pod communication. NATS messaging bus accepts unauthenticated connections from any pod in the namespace.
